[EN] This ledger must go to {@LinkCreature:241#1025$$Grunath} at Feral Valley Station. He's the prefect there, so he should know what to do with it.

You've risked your lives for us. Thank you, .
[ES] Este libro de contabilidad debe llegar a {@LinkCreature:241#1025$$Grunath} en Feral Valley Station. Él es el prefecto allí, así que debería saber qué hacer con él.

Has arriesgado tu vida por nosotros. Gracias, .

[EN] It would appear the selvaras thieves are abducting people and selling them to the Legion of Thulsa.

It's the legion we must watch closely from now on.
[ES] Parece que los ladrones selvaras están secuestrando gente y vendiéndola a la Legion of Thulsa.

Es a la legión a la que debemos vigilar de cerca a partir de ahora.
